assertions.title: Live preview updates on newsletter content changes

steps.action: Expand Newsletter card and set date range
steps.expected: Newsletter card expanded with editor visible
steps.observed: Newsletter card expanded showing heading field, TipTap toolbar, and content editor

steps.action: Type 'Hello from the newsletter!' in the TipTap editor body
steps.observed: Text typed successfully in editor content area

steps.action: Wait 600ms then check preview iframe content
steps.observed: Preview iframe contains 'Hello from the newsletter!' — confirmed via iframe contentDocument inspection

steps.action: Replace content with 'Updated newsletter content - second edit!'
steps.expected: New text replaces old text in editor

steps.action: Wait 600ms then check preview iframe content
steps.expected: Preview shows updated text, old text gone
steps.observed: Preview shows 'Updated newsletter content - second edit!' and does NOT contain 'Hello from the newsletter!' — real-time update confirmed

assertions.title: Rich text formatting renders in email HTML

steps.action: Set editor content with all formatting types via TipTap editor API: bold, italic, underline, text color, highlight, H2, H3, bullet list, link
steps.observed: Editor HTML confirmed: <strong>, <em>, <u>, <span style="color: rgb(255, 0, 0);">, <mark>, <h2>, <h3>, <ul><li>, <a href="https://example.com">

steps.action: Take screenshot of editor with formatted content (VAL-EMAIL-010-editor-with-formats.png)
steps.expected: Screenshot shows formatted text in editor

assertions.title: XSS sanitization of newsletter body in email output

steps.action: Set editor content with XSS payloads: , , ,
steps.observed: TipTap editor stripped all dangerous HTML — editor HTML shows only safe paragraphs and plain text 'javascript link'
Preview rendered without any alert dialogs or script execution

steps.action: Check HTML Code tab for XSS remnants
steps.expected: No <script>, onerror, javascript:, <iframe>, or alert() in email HTML
steps.observed:
Email HTML verification results:
- hasScript: false
- hasOnerror: false
- hasJavascript: false
- hasIframe: false
- hasAlert: false
- hasSafeText: true (safe text preserved)
- hasJavascriptLinkText: true (link text preserved, href stripped)

frictions.description: Could not access TipTap editor via .tiptap or React fiber; found editor instance via pm.editor property on .ProseMirror DOM element directly
frictions.resolution: Used document.querySelector('.ProseMirror').editor to access the TipTap editor API for setting content programmatically

frictions.description: HTML Code tab content was only accessible when the tab was selected; switching to Preview tab made the HTML panel invisible to querySelector
frictions.resolution: Ensured HTML Code tab was selected before extracting HTML content for verification

summary: Tested 3 assertions: all 3 passed. VAL-EMAIL-006: Live preview updates within 500ms on content changes. VAL-EMAIL-010: All rich text formatting (bold, italic, underline, color, highlight, headings, lists, links) renders with inline styles in email HTML. VAL-EMAIL-011: XSS payloads (script tags, onerror, javascript: URIs, iframes) are fully stripped from both editor and email output.
